summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 features: (1) Global mobile MobileMenu on 7 secondary pages, (2) Public tier badge on Members page, (3) Hide-tier toggle in Settings for subscribed users. All three features verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All pass.
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-seeded TesteurTier profile (test-vis-1) and paytest@stationexus.com account.
test_credentials: paytest@stationexus.com / password123 (active Mécène). Login is via AuthDialog (data-testid=account-login → auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit); there is NO /connexion route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MobileMenu: at 390x850, [data-testid=page-menu-btn] is visible on /bibliotheque, /membres, /contact, /parametres, /soutien, /tutoriel, /a-propos. At 1920x1080 the button is present in DOM (count=1) but hidden via md:hidden (visible=False) — correct. Drawer opens with [data-testid=page-menu-drawer], Accueil link navigates to /, and [data-testid=page-menu-close] closes it. Tier badge on /membres shows text ' Mécène' with gold color rgb(255,204,51), background srgb 1 0.8 0.2 / 0.2, border rgb(255,204,51). Icon overlay [data-testid=member-tier-icon-test-vis-1] present. Settings: after login and re-navigating to /parametres, [data-testid=settings-subscription] displays '✓ Abonné actif Palier Mécène …'. [data-testid=settings-hide-tier] is a real checkbox that starts checked (tier visible by default), toggles to unchecked and back cleanly; a success toast 'Ton palier est visible sur ton profil public.' appears. Console logs only show benign AudioContext autoplay warnings — no errors.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all three features working as specified.
